about_the_game:
When our story begins, Eleanor Rosewood has only just arrived in London. It’s 1898, and she dreams of becoming one of the city’s first female lawyers. Far from home and at the very start of her career, Eleanor is determined to prove herself in a world that does not welcome her easily.

Plagued by recurring nightmares about her father’s death, Eleanor struggles to move on until she witnesses a killing disturbingly similar to what she has seen in her dreams. What she once believed to be imagination may be something far more real… a vampire thought long gone.

As Eleanor begins to investigate, she crosses paths with two unlikely allies who have been hunting this vampire for years. Together, they must uncover the truth behind its return and the secrets buried deep within Victorian London.

  • Immerse Yourself in a Gothic 19th-Century World

    Feel the late 19th century gothic atmosphere permeate every aspect of the game. Throughout your journey, you'll confront the city's outcasts, dig through graves, fight to maintain your sanity in asylums, hunt down body snatchers, and uncover the secrets of ancient cults. And don't forget to seek the wisdom of the city's enigmatic witch.

    Key Features:

    • Point-and-Click Gothic Adventure: Prepare for a chilling story inspired by classic gothic literature like Dracula, Frankenstein and Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde, as well as modern classics like Hellboy.

    • Rich Hand-Drawn World: Dive into the opulent, hand-drawn world of Victorian London. Witness the decay of the 19th century through dynamic visuals.

    • Stunning Art & Storytelling: Experience the story through striking hand-drawn cutscenes, frame by frame animation, and detailed character portraits.

    • Engaging Characters: Interact with diverse and intriguing characters from every corner of Victorian society. Every Londoner has their own secrets, hidden lives, and motivations.

    • Unlikely Allies: Team up with a former Scotland Yard officer and a witch, each offering unique abilities; strength, weapons, and magic to overcome puzzles and obstacles.

    • Eleanor's Journal: Take notes! Record interesting findings in Eleanor’s notebook and refer back to them during your investigation.

    • Investigate & Unravel: Research your notes against Scotland Yard records or city guides. Discover new connections and illuminate the mysteries.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later, 64-bit versions only
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, and DX12-capable GPUs
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: In this point-and-click gothic adventure, Eleanor Rosewood, an aspiring lawyer newly arrived in London, will face a vampire haunting Victorian London. Gather evidence and seek help from London’s diverse populace, each with their own hidden lives and secrets, in this atmospheric game.
